trigger_or_condition: Aircraft power event or unacceptable supply behaviour at retrofit avionics
potential_effect: Display upset/failure or loss of intended cockpit function
control_or_response: Aircraft-power checks; OEM troubleshooting; hardware/configuration action; re-test/re-flight
status_boundary: Observed risk with return-to-flight evidence; detailed root cause not public

trigger_or_condition: Replacement display/LRU without complete restoration of required settings or databases
potential_effect: Incorrect/incomplete displayed capability or invalid as-tested configuration
control_or_response: Controlled restoration of settings/databases before functional re-test
status_boundary: Observed and reverified; exact private versions not public

trigger_or_condition: Radio transmit/PTT activity coincident with engine-indication fluctuation
potential_effect: Temporary corruption or instability of engine/airframe indication
control_or_response: Capture condition; isolate interface path; engage OEM; verify corrective action before closure
status_boundary: Observed; final corrective-action closure not reconstructed

potential_effect: ADAHRS compare/attitude recovery behaviour requiring interpretation or operational assessment
control_or_response: Record observation; obtain OEM functional explanation; evaluate against intended training/test context
status_boundary: Observed/characterised; final programme acceptance closure not reconstructed

trigger_or_condition: Selected glass-cockpit architecture must interoperate with retained NAV/transponder/audio functions
potential_effect: Loss or degradation of required retained function; added integration burden
control_or_response: Interface definition; OEM coordination; bench/installed checks as applicable
status_boundary: Integration activity evidenced; exact implementation detail withheld

trigger_or_condition: Failed LRU or configuration-dependent replacement without timely spare/repair path
potential_effect: Extended downtime or inability to restore the verified configuration
control_or_response: Spare-LRU concept; OEM repair/support loop; configuration restoration process
status_boundary: Supportability concern and response evidenced; quantitative availability data not reconstructed
